item.description:
• See your month, today's agenda and world clocks in a glass panel right from the menu bar
  • Join Zoom, Google Meet, Teams and more in one click, with a countdown to your next meeting
  • Get reminded before meetings with notifications, a full screen alert or a playful plane banner
  • Create events by typing naturally, like "Dentist next Friday 9:30", with Apple Intelligence
  • Slide through time with world clocks to find a good meeting slot across time zones
  • See and complete your reminders right in the agenda
  • Make it yours with themes, fonts, an hourly chime and keyboard shortcuts
  • Available in English, Spanish, Japanese and Simplified Chinese
